Opponents of voting rights lack the common sense to understand that these anti-voting conspiracy theories are just flat-out lies. They'd rather see a vast web of shadowy interests arrayed against them than reexamine their own values when they lose elections.
That's why they create bills like the SAVE America, SAVE, and MEGA Acts, to strip our fundamental right to vote until only their select few have the privilege to vote. They simply don't believe we all deserve to vote.
Step up with $35 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act and defend our right to vote from these vicious attacks >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062526_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
KATU: Vance calls on Congressional Republicans to pass SAVE Act during speech [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062526_3&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again this week, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062526_3&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062526_3&amount=35]

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "

Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Overtime should mean double the wage
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The American people are facing an affordability crisis as skyrocketing inflation outpaces workers’ wages.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260625-6397-footer&t=1&akid=6397%2E420207%2EQsmoa2)
Peter,
The American people are facing an affordability crisis as skyrocketing inflation outpaces workers’ wages.
Right now, 76% of Americans say the cost of living is their biggest economic concern, with 65% saying a middle-class lifestyle is out of reach and 77% saying it’s harder to achieve than a decade ago. In 49 states, the average renter’s wage isn’t enough to afford a two-bedroom apartment. In 37 states, it’s not even enough for a one-bedroom.
Meanwhile, 41% of workers report starting early or finishing late every single day.
**That’s why I’m proud to be co-leading the Double the Wage for Overtime Act, which would raise the federal overtime pay to double a worker’s wage for every hour worked over 40 a week, from the current rate of a time and a half.**
For example, someone who makes $25 an hour and works 10 hours overtime each week would make $6,500 more each year as a result of this bill.
This legislation will ensure that hardworking Americans get the pay they deserve while also deterring corporations from forcing workers into long, unsustainable hours.
It’s just one of many steps we need to take to address the affordability crisis that working people are facing right now. I’m going to keep pushing to get this legislation passed, but I’m counting on your support to keep growing this movement.
[**If you’re with me, will you pitch in $3, or any amount you can, to help me keep fighting for legislation that will make a real difference for working people?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260625.s3-n9X&refcode=em20260625-6397&amount=3&t=2&akid=6397%2E420207%2EQsmoa2)

# **🚨 📺 NEW TV AD IS LIVE 📺 🚨 **
Twenty years ago, I became an American citizen, and I truly can think of no other place on earth where a young immigrant has the opportunity to grow up and one day serve as a member of Congress.

My dad drove a bus, my mom cleaned houses, and I flipped burgers as my family worked to build a better future for me and my sisters here in the United States of America. Like so many families across Arizona, we were looking for opportunity.

_**We simply wanted a shot at the American Dream.**_ _**That's what I fight for every day.**_

But the more time I've spent in Washington, the more frustrated I've become watching politicians put themselves first. Families are working hard every single day just to make ends meet, yet too many elected officials are getting rich from the positions voters entrusted to them.

_**So I did something about it.**_

I stood up to both parties and sponsored legislation to ban congressional insider trading because members of Congress should never be allowed to profit from information unavailable to the American people. Despite what some politicians believe, public office is a responsibility, not an opportunity to get rich.

I haven't forgotten where I came from, and I never will.

**I don’t work for Washington. I work for YOU.**

| | Peter Willis, For years, Washington promised solutions and delivered excuses.

**That's changing.**

President Trump is securing the border, restoring American strength, and putting hardworking Americans first.

And **we're delivering results.**

We passed tax relief that helps families keep more of their hard-earned money. We're working to strengthen our economy, support agriculture, and ensure Kansas families have a stronger future.

But let's be honest: **the fight isn't over.**

The Left is still pushing bigger government, higher spending, and the same failed policies that drove up costs and weakened our country.

That's why I'm continuing to fight every day for Kansas values in Congress.
* **Secure border.**
* **Lower taxes.**
* **Strong agriculture.**
* **More freedom.**
* **Safer communities.**

And right now, we're approaching an important quarterly fundraising deadline.

At the end of the month, campaigns across the country will report their fundraising numbers. Political insiders, outside groups, and potential challengers will all be looking at the results.

**We need to show strength.**

We need to show momentum.

**And we need to show that Kansas conservatives are standing behind our efforts to keep delivering results.**

We’ve got two big wins to share:
Yesterday, we secured a final ruling in our push to permanently block key provisions of Trump’s executive order that attempted to take over state election processes and impose vast voting restrictions across the country.
This executive order was unconstitutional, antidemocratic, and un-American — so as we do when the President brazenly violates the law, we sued. And as we do when we fight with the law on our side, we won .

This order (also unconstitutional, of course) would have interfered with states’ authority to run our own elections by restricting mail-in voting and voter eligibility.
Trump tried to rewrite the rules of our elections through illegal power grabs. We fought back. We won.
These wins are thanks to your support — we can’t do any of this without you. Will you keep it going by chipping in any amount today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

# **Senator Hughes Honored with Social Justice Warrior Award**
Senator Hughes was honored to receive the Social Justice Warrior Award from the [Alliance of Community Service Providers](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17595).
Senator Hughes was recognized for his unwavering commitment to protecting and strengthening the social safety net that so many Pennsylvanians rely on.

**Social justice remains a top priority for Senator Hughes**
Senator Hughes has always been an advocate for policies that uplift vulnerable populations and ensure that all Pennsylvanians have access to the care and support they need.
As we started to feel the impact of the chaos and cuts that were coming out of Washington DC in President Trump's second term, Senator Hughes stayed relentless in speaking out for the need to stop federal cuts. He's done everything he can at the state level to push back against cuts to healthcare, SNAP benefits, and social support programs.

**We are stronger together**
Senator Hughes also stands with [the dedicated professionals who serve the community each day](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17596), championing the workforce that is on the front lines of providing supports and services for vulnerable populations. He is committed to being an advocate for funding and legislation that pays these workers a living wage and allows them to live with dignity.

* * *

**Stay in Touch on Social Media**
If you haven't visited Senator Hughes' [Facebook page](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17597), join the conversation by 'liking' the page and following our office on [X](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17598), [Bluesky](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17599), [Instagram](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17600), and [TikTok](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17602). We have lots of information available on these pages about community events and issues affecting our district. If you have questions or concerns, send us an email at [hughes@pasenate.com](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171984.172929.113&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17589).

## Supreme Court Strikes Down Hawaii Gun Law
The Supreme Court on Thursday [struck down](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMiPTAw0EDi4hm0svRB67gT4ZG9lmrNmvX7G_sFlJJVW9qn_P5anZsd_-6oNUXsPiqSRHOVNctstHSjmyyRx8eFPMV_RkzQISUEgUgIvV7D5LV1u1EgE9alLtMEKHY49DvatB9riasX11dpSgaZTjJBG6DjTayUw1qztNImAr5QR907_Irv2IjxVbi3qoOkmWc4jN_8A-77S6zw3TmHDUTu05n6l6_KlgrmAupTTmle4Vt1_BfMsK5nSdkQ4SJlwxi10XzSy2ywuniyjBrSFa8RYunPQlLBlOHHwFcx2VPQs7xwlvlO3Q7H6q86_-eiv4DgAA___mQoFJ) a Hawaii law barring concealed-carry holders from bringing guns into public-facing businesses without the owner's permission. The vote was 6-3. Critics called it the "[vampire rule](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOpSAYBeCn0Q6DqKgFxTZ2d9stDcKP_hsEA7-XuW8_cV5h6pOcfOf8e60vjR7D_lefoMjFNUDJHoggrfsdEmRKaAhjiG9IdKcA1qyCC8m4ZEKuVqP_rH1tlQMQ0NWg2nESvZwGOdaHctC7ru2kdsZO3chnM7VOz9vGu1nIdqtRPW1cCtlyPouhGTawbphk52RrpR6rnoNFiqn5HzHQAc5_Hkxj4ll7dRBduer-VGKpxFJKaVz8elY8eSWWK3okNLkSS76vBCcwE-9ELIOJwTJ9QrAnBGIFAzMxGNAeLDM6pQ_b_A0skyZg-x3YoYtGrJOyV0HvMcuHt58a_Q-HfvXhW4nvAAAA__-uTYpa)," since gun owners needed an invitation to enter shops or restaurants. Hawaii adopted it after a 2022 Supreme Court ruling broadened the right to carry. In the majority opinion, Justice Samuel Alito wrote that the law hobbled Second Amendment rights, exposing lawful carriers to criminal charges for routine errands. [Read the majority opinion here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuhDAQBNCvge6QvYfXpHCRhu7SprR8eM1tZGxkDOj-PiK_kGq6eaP5ftiH48hp_nILmRqyTXRukWqlYuc9Fdpq4alyTvmgUveSyE8WBOBN4A3QesfxbfvWm0AEdG_JSD1Aj4NC3b6M8loQDVrSU2qH9JRuCCqgBtQ9atGyudoEAkohPkB16kk-qAHvAaVHp5tekOeaS_eTOdUXhfi-xnRTXtpoXrWuW3P_bGBsYDzPs9v2tdBCU95L7eZ8NDDmlRPntDUwglp9uLK_SdGjTQvnbvWhLcavJ8fIG17mvDiOf0b91zGHgd8AAAD__16Id54). Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, joined by Justice Sonia Sotomayor, [filed a dissent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNpB5mBcYPHRhS9eOlrGfiSvHjuyXoPTrK_oLne_VuVfn66qvJsSQ9k9zJ8U-60RHjcRMRe_PVKhyCZZDTvlFhZ8lkbMaBGAnsAPUzoT41rJ1yhMBjS2p4TKDxHnCS3tT5GECKf2ybDhKsLT4cVsWKQbc0Pi5DeqkCQQchFhg6qeNnJ9mHD0ODs2lkYJc4Fz67xwS38jH93mmt_neRnVjftRm_GhgbWA9jqOvNvOzbjHvZ6WB1ZpK9Qxz9Lm47tXF_KCfBta2KPc4Qoyh4jm0302If2D-l42Xgt8AAAD__7JmdMw), calling it a property-rights dispute. The ruling could threaten similar restrictions in New York and California.
## Twin Quakes Devastate Venezuela
Two powerful earthquakes [struck northern Venezuela](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSnDAQRU8jMk2JHhAQKHBCNk4dUj2oBbI1EpYaqNnTb7F7hE066V-v3v9_HtMDffBx-Y0vMuzSFOksgZgpT8seMxXOfmafYjoo854j2XkCBVoqLUFPFn14T01ljSMCuldk6q6HRvet7qrV6Gboh27o6sbW-LRW9zU5183PHq3Cvqu8uWhKg66VGqC9tU-yru313enaauxEo8h6Tvn2N_nIK7nwvmRuc3pVwazMWxH3XwJGAWN8b6nw9RIwXmABo7oOtALGM-Vg5VVRwHhQpI-dAkrCzOv_Hf9RkcEfJPfNIlOR6JiytHRgYWQfF8mnj_I7KmCssrHb6UPwRV-eywt9-PLiH415GPgMAAD__5DvisU) within a minute of each other on Wednesday, killing at least 188 people and injuring over 1,500. Measured at magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5, the back-to-back quakes were the country's strongest in over a century. Photos show apartment blocks folded into rubble, with families sleeping in the streets for fear of aftershocks. [See photos here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D3unDAQBfDTmM4rf2GgcBEpQkqxaVOiwR7AibE3ZtjV5vQRe4V_PZqn33u_7tMdYop5_Qk7OlrKlPF1JCTCOq1nrnhQjZ5iyeWJlc6aMfhJCWW5sFzZKUBM78k0wS2ICnWDTna9MrZvbddsDhYpbfBoZ6u1nwcrOxDoTWeEwUWLJrorTVhlpRCDam_tjGFpe6sXK4OFjhmBIVKpt98lZtpwSe8Lc_Nlb5LbiB4H09-YGpkaYfZXg-vG1PgjE9YMFx8SU-NBteSVd5LvsOZIZ0COUGn7e8If5BV9qQED9wUO4k_M-O_EBJ_PUt9MjzEw_V1qI_t2GExTXXi8YkrxsJdz3SGmj4u-NObTqf8BAAD__0fXiro). President Trump pledged American aid, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the U.S. is [rushing rescue teams](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFypDAQRL9GZGyhAQkIFFxCtpdeSA1oWOYspLUYdgt_vQv_guOu6n79_t3HO3Lg-PiLGzlZ0hjpvQcSoTw-jphpl8yzcIrpRVmOHMnPI1Rgy8qWYEePHM6xKbxbiIDqgpxuO2hsZ2xbrK5tTW3qyda6m7SmdpoW1I0hj33XaLMU7K62yoLVVdWDuZmJ_GI6Wy9We4utairyLCnf_ieOstISzgvmNqetCG4Vee6q_qNgUDDISiuHcGUKhmcKPJ8KBo5COeL1A4OCwfRN1euuPPZy48CC-SyRffmiSF8HBSwJs6yfB37QrmAosvPPN4fAu72AHhvyz0ghv7L2cvAdAAD__6Y4gq0) and supplies to help with disaster recovery. Brazil, Mexico, and El Salvador are also sending crews. The toll is expected to climb. The [U.S. Geological Survey warned](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyszAQhJ8GOjHSIQQUKv7Gnf82JXNGJ6NYSI44zDhPnyGvkH5nv93v4zpdMcSQ7v9xJcs-T4mOLRIzlem-p0IblzBzyCm_qPBeErl5AglGSCPATA5DfE-6dtYTAbU1WdUPoM3Qmb5ebCu1Q5Sj152GoRtJ-ptHpcipsdVAdbBnmzRglJQjdE13I-e7wbTeKGewr7QkFziX5jOHxAv5-D7HNHNe62gX5udWtf8quFRwOY6jOS8cRI8zUMGFsPDyteODxIsSfe8UUaw5McYbJtELJWYsOOMmFCjVg1J1se55hBjDZk7-fcUQf3n8J0kvCz8BAAD__2eifE0) the total number of deaths could keep growing, with dozens of aftershocks still rattling the region.
## Amazon Beats Walmart as Biggest Company
Amazon dethroned Walmart as [America's biggest company](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL8GMlFCiDEOFFxC5ksvpMZowHMrJEoam_J-_Rb-hc27ul-_f7fphhw4rn9xIydLmiIdJZAI5Wl9xkxFMs_CKaYXZXnmSH6ejDagNCgDk0cO78nW3i1EhrqaXHsZjIWhh0v9cLYjc--1JW1xsK0fehjgCp1uCdEOULM72zQYaLW-mr7p7-SXfoBugdYDXiqrybOk3PxPHOVBS3ifMM2ctjq4h8hequ5PZcbKjMdxNC8uTwwz7iwYuMgZrMyIG36nqD4_8IuKOjBsmEVhUbhR5hmLuvO6UhE1p23H-K7MWGfn94ND4AIny7ohh8-2_ErYy5mfAAAA__-2k4JX), taking the top spot on the Fortune 500 this month for the first time. It was close: Amazon brought in $716.9 billion in revenue last year, narrowly edging Walmart's $713.2 billion. Walmart has been the nation's biggest company for the past 13 years. The climb is the real story. Amazon first joined the list at No. 492 about two decades ago, and is just the fourth company ever to reach the summit as the nation's biggest company. The others were General Motors, ExxonMobil, and Walmart itself, now in second place as e-commerce and cloud computing reshape the economy. [See the full chart here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSozAQRL8GMlFCiDEOFFxC5ksvpMZowHMrJEoam_J-_Rb-hc27ul-_f7fphhw4rn9xIydLmiIdJZAI5Wl9xkxFMs_CKaYXZXnmSH6ejDagNCgDk0cO78nW3i1EhrqaXHsZjIWhh0v9cLYjc--1JW1xsK0fehjgCp1uCdEOULM72zQYaLW-mr7p7-SXfoBugdYDXiqrybOk3PxPHOVBS3ifMM2ctjq4h8hequ5PZcbKjMdxNC8uTwwz7iwYuMgZrMyIG36nqD4_8IuKOjBsmEVhUbhR5hmLuvO6UhE1p23H-K7MWGfn94ND4AIny7ohh8-2_ErYy5mfAAAA__-2k4JX).
